title: Implement real Qdrant vector adapter

context.summary: Replace the Qdrant package with a working vector backend adapter.
context.background: Qdrant is configured in Compose and env but the package must implement the same operational contract as pgvector.

in: Implement Qdrant collection bootstrap, healthcheck, chunk upsert, search, delete and reindex operations.
Preserve source refs and project scoping in Qdrant payloads.
Add integration tests against the Qdrant Compose profile.
Update config/docs for real Qdrant operation.
Remove TASK-90-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Switching the default backend away from pgvector.
Implementing vector backend selection across the full runtime.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/vector-qdrant implements the required vector index contract.
Qdrant collections are created or validated idempotently.
Chunk search returns document/chunk source refs compatible with pgvector search.
Qdrant integration tests run against a real Qdrant service.

manual_checks: Confirm Qdrant package contains no not-implemented paths.
Confirm Qdrant profile healthcheck passes before tests use it.

risks: Qdrant payload schema must remain compatible with existing search responses.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
